reasoning: Both attempts are correct and pass every check. A reads StarterKit at its exact built path with WaitForChild, keeps its changes in new files, and uses only standard syntax. B's client logic is somewhat more robust, but it finds StarterKit with a loose recursive search and rewrites existing files with const syntax and @game requires, which this review can't confirm work at runtime on Roblox. A is the cleaner change to merge.
